tables.name: Accounts
tables.row_identity: account_id plus snapshot_date is not explicitly declared unique
tables.grain: account balance snapshot at date; balance is non-additive across dates

measures.name: balance
measures.basis: The May filter crosses multiple daily snapshots, and balance is documented as non-additive across dates. The many-to-one Calendar join does not itself establish duplication. The quoted claim that summing balances yields deposits is unsupported.

sequence: Join Accounts to Calendar on Accounts.snapshot_date = Calendar.date.
risks: Summing daily snapshots is structurally unsafe across dates.
No rule converts balances into deposits; the quoted source note conflicts with the supplied measure definition.
alternatives: Conditional: select one approved snapshot per account or use another supplied snapshot rule, if the intended result is a point-in-time balance.
Defining a deposit-flow measure is outside this assessment and requires an explicit business rule.
